title: Student Health: Fees and Deadlines
text:
Student Health: Fees and Deadlines (covers 2026-27 and later years as listed).

WHO PAYS THE STUDENT HEALTH FEE
- Fall and spring: required for students enrolled in 6 or more units, all international students, and all Health Sciences Campus degree students.
- Summer: applies to students enrolled in summer courses. Non-registered matriculated students (continuing students, May graduates of the current academic year, and fall admits for the upcoming year) may opt in for one or both summer sessions.

INSURANCE (SHIP/Aetna) AND WAIVER DEADLINES
- Full-time, international, and health professions students are automatically enrolled, and charges appear on the semester bill.
- Students bringing another plan must apply for a waiver by:
  - Fall 2026: September 11, 2026 (already passed as of November 2026)
  - Spring 2027: January 29, 2027
  - Fall 2027: September 10, 2027; Spring 2028: January 28, 2028
  - Fall 2028: September 8, 2028; Spring 2029: January 26, 2029
- Student athletes: decide before the first day of practice and no later than August 15 each year.
- The page does not explain how to submit a waiver. Contact studenthealth@usc.edu for instructions.

SHIP/AETNA COPAYS
- $20 for medical visits (in-person or telehealth) with Tier 1 or Tier 2 providers.
- $10 for mental and behavioral health visits with Tier 1 or Tier 2 providers.
- $50 for walk-in or urgent care visits at insurance-based urgent care centers.

APPOINTMENTS AND LATE POLICY
- Medical visits are covered by the Student Health Fee, so insurance and copays do not apply. Specialist visits require a referral from a USC Student Health provider.
- Book and reschedule through MySHR at usc.edu/myshr. The page gives no step-by-step booking instructions.
- Arriving 10 or more minutes late cancels a medical appointment. Students must reschedule through MySHR.
- Payment: students have five business days to choose a payment method (in person, via MySHR, or by phone). Otherwise charges go to their university financial account.

COUNSELING AND MENTAL HEALTH
- Individual, group, referral, crisis, and psychiatry services are covered by the Student Health Fee.
- Cancellations with less than 12 hours' notice, or no-shows, cost $20.
- WELL phone line: (213) 740-9355, with 24/7 phone coverage for connecting to services. This is the only phone number on the page; no separate counseling line is listed.

CONTACT
- Email: studenthealth@usc.edu.
- Hours are on a 'Location and Hours' page that was not included in this extract.
